title: Resistivity and Conductivity
learning_objectives: Connect the idea to a real-world example
voiceover: Watch how the diagram builds step by step.
Connect each label to the core idea.
Think of resistivity like the roughness inside a water pipe—narrow or rusty pipes resist water flow, just as materials with high resistivity…
Pause and restate what Resistivity and Conductivity means.
